species.name: Trout
why: Water 63°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 38–42 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.

species.name: Kokanee
why: Water 63°F on top, warmer than they like, so they go deeper and into the shade.
Best water today is 44–56 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.

species.name: Smallmouth bass
why: Water 63°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.

The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
